Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
Yes, damaged items are handled specifically through our damage claim process rather than a standard return.
When an item arrives damaged, our Customer Care team assists you with filing a claim. Based on the claim result, we will send you a replacement, issue a store credit, or process a full refund for the damaged product.
